title: APP SONAR full-ranking ordinal skill against exact 5-of-40 null
hypothesis: The complete ordinal order of the 40 numbers emitted by the exact APP SONAR scorer contains useful information about the next draw beyond the Top20 set: drawn numbers should occupy smaller ranks more often than a uniformly random 5-of-40 subset.

estimand.forecast: For target index t, execute the exact committed sonarAnalogCore on draws[0:t] and retain its 40-number score order; target draw is excluded.
estimand.rank_sum: R_t = sum of the one-based APP ranks of the five target numbers; lower is better.
estimand.primary_endpoint: Mean rank of the five drawn numbers over the Blind OOS; exact uniform-null expectation is 20.5.
secondary_endpoints: Mean number of target hits in APP ranks 1-5; exact null expectation 0.625.
Mean number of target hits in APP ranks 1-10; exact null expectation 1.25.
Mean number of target hits in APP ranks 1-20; exact null expectation 2.5.
estimand.null: Conditional on each prior-only ranking, the five drawn ranks are a uniform 5-subset of {1,...,40}; rank-sum distribution is the exact 5-of-40 subset distribution and TopK hit counts are Hypergeometric(40,K,5).

models.M0: Exact conditional random-ranking null: every target is a uniform 5-of-40 subset of ranks; E(mean rank)=20.5 and E(TopK hits)=K/8.
models.M1: Exact APP SONAR 40-rank ordering from the committed sonarAnalogCore; no parameter fitting or post-hoc reranking.
models.controls: Top5, Top10, and Top20 cumulative hit means are secondary controls; full-rank mean is the single primary endpoint.

sample.split_rule: 60% discovery, 20% validation, remainder Blind OOS after the 200-draw warmup; first two split sizes use Math.round.

inference.primary_test: One-sided exact conditional-randomization Monte Carlo for the aggregate rank-sum, 50,000 replicates; each replicate samples 641 independent uniform 5-subsets of ranks and compares the aggregate rank sum (lower is better).
inference.secondary_tests: Exact convolution of Hypergeometric(40,K,5) for K=5,10,20 across 641 targets; one-sided upper-tail probabilities.
inference.multiple_testing: Holm across the four pre-specified Blind OOS endpoints.
inference.confidence_intervals: Circular moving-block bootstrap, 10,000 replicates, block length 20, percentile 95% intervals for mean rank and TopK hit means.
inference.random_seed: Fixed xorshift32 seeds persisted in runner; no run-time entropy.

leakage_controls: Pin canonical archive, exact APP scorer source, and APP modelDraws blob SHAs.
For every target t, execute the scorer on draws[0:t] only; target outcome is scored only after ranking is frozen.
Verify archive and APP modelDraws reconcile row-by-row.
Verify all 40 ranks are unique and deterministic; ties use the exact committed smaller-number tie-break.
Mutate the target and future suffix at nine fixed target indices and verify the current 40-rank order remains unchanged.
Verify every ledger cutoff date is strictly earlier than its target date.
Replay report, ledger, validation, freeze, checkpoint, and manifest byte-for-byte.
guardrails: Research-only diagnostic; no production scorer or ranking changes.
Prospective Q123 freeze is separate and is not a Q60 paired freeze.
No Q60 gate edits and no reconstructed historical freezes.
Historical Blind OOS is not a virgin holdout after prior SONAR exploration.
No automatic merge or engine promotion.
decision_rule: Retain ordinal ranking only as a supported research signal if the primary Blind OOS mean-rank endpoint improves over 20.5 with Holm-adjusted p<0.05 and at least one cumulative TopK endpoint is directionally consistent. Otherwise record a null/negative result. No production promotion.
